title: Glyph-eyed blob crowd into dotted claim and lockup
summary: One pale round face with type-glyph eyes pulls out from macro, blinks through expressions, gets crowded by coloured faces, then the crowd collapses to dots that trace a short number claim and resolve into a three-colour event lockup.
use_when: A playful event or launch-day teaser with a friendly, character-led voice
A silent short where one numeric claim and a name lockup are the whole message
Brands with a 4-5 colour accent palette that can be shown as characters
Opening sting before a longer keynote or launch-week recap

look.type_style: geometric grotesk, medium weight, sentence case, normal tracking; claim ~14 % H at its large state, ~4 % H once extended; lockup ~4 % H in three colours (white name, green word, purple bracketed year); face glyphs are bold black type characters

sfx.event: face glyph eyes swap expression (blink / squint)
coloured faces push into frame around the hero face

structure.shot: extreme close-up on a pale grey round face filling the frame, two black asterisk glyphs as eyes, black background at the edges
structure.camera: pull-out: face width ~1.4 W -> ~0.6 W over 16 fr (sheet-01 cells 0-2), decelerating
structure.motion: easings.outExpo pull-out ~16 fr (±0.25 s); slight rotation of the face (~5 deg/s from motion.json)

structure.shot: the single face settles centred at ~0.37 H diameter and cycles eye glyphs: asterisks, short dashes (blink), small circles, angle brackets (squint)
structure.camera: pull-out continues to ~0.33 H by 1.00, then near static (-15 %/s in 1-2 s, ~0 %/s after 2.00)
structure.motion: face drifts and wobbles a few px; eye glyphs swap on hard frame changes about every 0.25-0.5 s (±0.25 s); eyes shift position as the face turns; springs.pop suggested for each swap (overshoot not measurable)

structure.shot: five coloured faces (orange, green, near-black, purple, blue) push in from the frame edges and pack tightly around the grey one; each has its own glyph eyes (dashes, plus signs, carets, circles, angle brackets)
structure.camera: slight push then hold: neighbours enter 2.27-3.00, crowd settles by 3.00 with faces touching (sheet-01 cells 9-15, sheet-02 cell 0)
structure.motion: faces slide in from off-frame edges, springs.heavy suggested (~20 fr, ±0.25 s); all faces keep swapping eye glyphs independently every ~0.25-0.5 s; grey face grows slightly as the crowd fills in

structure.shot: the crowd shrinks at different rates and gaps open; by 4.77 only a small purple face and a single blue dot remain on black
structure.camera: pull-out / shrink: faces scale ~-60 %/s (motion.json 4-5 s), each face shrinking toward its own point
structure.motion: per-face scale-down to a dot, staggered ~3-5 fr (±0.25 s), easings.inExpo into the collapse; faces drift toward frame centre

structure.shot: a scatter of orange dots in the centre traces the outline of a short claim (a number and a unit, 2 words, with a period); outlines fill to solid white; large, ~14 % H
structure.motion: dots gather into glyph outlines 5.00-5.50, outline strokes appear 5.27, letters fill white by 5.77; leftover dots cling to the strokes then fade; particle gather ~22 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: the claim drops to ~4 % H and a second 2-word part (a count with a plus, then a noun, with a period) is appended on the same line; new words appear as orange dotted outlines and fill white left to right
structure.motion: scale jump from large to small between 6.00 and 6.27 (≤ 7 fr, not measurable); appended words resolve dot -> outline -> white over 6.27-7.50, sweeping left to right, last word last; holds 7.50-8.00

structure.shot: event lockup on one line, ~4 % H centred: white company name, green event word, purple year in brackets
structure.motion: claim dissolves into scrambled dotted glyphs that decode left to right into the lockup over 8.27-9.27 (~30 fr): name first, event word by 8.77, bracketed year last at 9.27; colours tint in from blue-green to final; hold 85 fr to the end

params.brand: brand.json: bg black, fg light grey for the hero face, 5 accent colours for the crowd faces and lockup
params.content.faces: 6 faces: colour + list of eye glyph pairs to cycle (e.g. asterisks, dashes, circles, angle brackets, plus signs, carets)
params.content.claim: short numeric claim, 2 words with a period
params.content.claimExtra: second part appended after the shrink, 2 words with a period
params.content.lockup: three parts: name (fg), event word (accent 1), year/version in brackets (accent 2)
params.timing.faceSwap: frames between eye glyph swaps (default ~8-12 at 30 fps, suggested)

notes: One continuous shot, no hard cuts; cuts.json soft entries at 0.33-0.70 and 4.20-4.63 are the opening pull-out and the crowd collapse, both inside the same shot, so transitions are continuous. Silent reference: every SFX is planned by the glue rule, not observed. All times from 4 fps sheets (±0.25 s); spring names, glyph swap rate and staggers are suggested defaults, not measured. Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): glyph-face (round character with type-glyph eyes that swap expressions), crowd-pack (characters push in and pack around a hero), glyph-decode (scrambled dotted glyphs resolve into a lockup left to right). Catalogue hint said product-ui; there is no UI, so family is launch-film. Difficulty per rule is easy (3 techniques), but the face character system has to be built from scratch.
